services.desc: This powerful Docu-Concert brings to life the music and story of one of the most versatile and influential vocalists of the 20th century. From heart-wrenching ballads to country-rock anthems, this acclaimed live tribute captures the essence of Ronstadt’s remarkable life and career with a dynamic performance that resonates with fans old and new. The Linda Ronstadt Show is not like any other tribute! This show is like a rock concert and a musical rolled into one-combining the power of live music, heartfelt storytelling, and rare video footage.
